hero.lead: A smarter way for South African learners to understand, practise and master their schoolwork — with lessons, guided help, practice and progress all in one place.

makeSense.title: Learning should make sense.
makeSense.lead: When a child is stuck, they usually don't need the answer. They need the one step they missed. Hand over the answer and the gap stays; explain the step and it closes.

confused.label: Confused
confused.body: The worksheet may as well be in another language. Nothing in it connects to anything they already know.

explained.label: Explained
explained.body: The concept is broken into steps, in words and pictures that fit where they actually are.

practised.label: Practised
practised.body: They try it themselves, and every answer is explained — right or wrong.

mastered.label: Mastered
mastered.body: They can do it without help. Progress records it, so you both know it's real.

makeSense.closing: Understand it. Practise it. Master it.

flow.title: Four steps, every time.
flow.lead: The same loop whether it's homework tonight or revision before exams.

snap.title: Snap it
snap.body: Take a photo of schoolwork, notes, a worksheet or a document. StudyLegends reads it and works out which topic it belongs to.

understand.title: Understand it
understand.body: The concept is explained at the learner's level — short, plain and visual, in English or Afrikaans.

practise.title: Practise it
practise.body: Interactive questions follow straight away, each one marked on the spot with an explanation of why the answer is what it is.

master.title: Master it
master.body: Progress tracking shows which topics are solid and which still need another pass, per subject and per topic.

master.note: Natural Sciences needs another pass — practice is suggested automatically.

tutor.reply1: Let's break it down together. A fraction is just a whole thing cut into equal parts.
tutor.reply2: In 3/4, the bottom number says how many equal parts the whole was cut into — 4. The top number says how many of those parts you have — 3.
tutor.reply3: So 3/4 of a chocolate slab cut into 4 pieces means you have 3 of the 4 pieces.
tutor.reply4: Exactly that. Now try one yourself — what is 3/5 of 40?

practice.explanation: First find one fifth: 40 ÷ 5 = 8. Then take three of them: 3 × 8 = 24.

tutorSection.titleLine2: they don't have to stay stuck.
tutorSection.lead: It's 8pm, the worksheet is due tomorrow and nobody at home remembers how to do it. That is the moment this is built for.
tutorSection.commitment: StudyLegends is built to explain, not to answer. It walks a learner through the thinking step by step and then asks them to try it — because a copied answer teaches nothing and shows up in the next test.

explanation.title: Explanation first
explanation.body: The concept in plain language, pitched at the grade the learner is actually in.

visual.title: Then a visual
visual.body: Shown as parts, shapes, number lines or diagrams — whatever makes the idea land.

worked.title: Then a worked example
worked.body: One problem solved all the way through, with the reason for each step.

tryIt.title: Then they try
tryIt.body: The learner does the next one. This is the step a homework-answer tool skips.

practice.title: Then practice
practice.body: More questions on the same topic until it holds, each marked with an explanation.

progress.title: See learning happen.
progress.lead: Not screen time, not badges earned — which topics are solid, which need another pass, and what was actually practised.

safety.lead: The safest features are the ones that don't exist. Here is what we deliberately left out, and what we check before anything reaches your child.

noMessaging.title: No messaging
noMessaging.body: There is no way for a learner to message another learner, or for a stranger to message them. The feature does not exist.

noProfiles.title: No public profiles
noProfiles.body: Nothing about your child is visible to anyone outside your household account.

parentHeld.title: Parent-held accounts
parentHeld.body: A learner profile is created by a parent inside a parent account. Children do not sign themselves up.

reviewedVideo.title: Every video reviewed
reviewedVideo.body: Suggested videos are watched in full and approved by a person on our team before a learner can see one.

noAds.title: No ads, no selling data
noAds.body: There are no adverts in the product and we do not sell personal information.

plainTerms.title: Terms in plain language
plainTerms.body: What we collect and why is written to be read, not to be skimmed past.
